rust_summary: Shared HUD corner placement and scaled GUI dimensions.
doc_summary: In the HUD hook, `hud_place(corners, corner, [width, height])` reserves space in the actual shared stack and returns its top-left GUI-pixel position. Hidden debug corners and invalid sizes return None without reserving space. `gui_size()` returns [width, height] in scaled GUI pixels. Requires API @API:hud_layout@.
